facts.claim: The Church of England is represented in Bangalore by three chaplains, another clergyman, and an S.P.G. missionary.
facts.quote: The Churcli of Englaiid vs, represented by three chaplains, one other clergyman, and one S.P.G. missionary in Bangalore, and one chaplain at Mysore, all under the Bishop of Madras.

facts.claim: There are six established churches belonging to the Church of England.
facts.quote: The number of churches on the establishment is six, and the number of persons returned in the census as belonging to the Church of England is 5,366

facts.claim: Two American Methodist Episcopal churches have been established in Bangalore since 1880.
